summary: Phase-6 verification PASSED for all three new features. Backend pytest (test_phase6.py): 10/10 green — Detection overlay returns xsoar_live=true with MITRE heatmap + rules[] (fp_rate/precision/recall) for tenant 'acme-corp' and correctly falls back to mock (no xsoar_live) for 'globalbank'; IRIS /copilot/chat with tenant_id=acme-corp answers the 'highest FP rate' question referencing Suspicious PowerShell (source='rule' fallback per PS — expected); Report schedules full CRUD works (POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE) and /run-now returns ran=true with mode='console' and the run is recorded in /api/email/history with a .pptx attachment. All 5 dashboards regress cleanly on tenant=all. Frontend Playwright (admin login → tenant switch to Acme → /detection → /settings → IRIS): 'Live · XSOAR' badge (det-xsoar-live) present, mitre-heatmap rendered with uploaded tactics (Execution 100% / Impact 75% / Initial Access 75% / Command and Control 50%), Rule Effectiveness table shows Suspicious PowerShell (tuning) 75% FP as highest, followed by DNS Tunneling 50%, Impossible Travel 33.3%, Ransomware File Ext 0%. Scheduled Email Reports card creates a schedule, sched-runnow-<id> executes (backend 200 ok), sched-toggle flips 'Pause'→'Resume', sched-delete removes the row. IRIS launcher opens the chat, FP-rate question returns an answer containing 'powershell', 'fp' and '%' (grounded on live_xsoar).

minor.issue: Requires full ReportScheduleBody (frequency/recipients mandatory) to toggle 'enabled'; a partial-patch shape would be more idiomatic but current UI sends full payload so behavior is correct.

issues: No visible success toast captured after Send-now (backend call succeeds and row updates last_run); consider surfacing a sonner/toaster confirmation for better UX. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /reports/schedules/{id} rebuilds updates dict from full ReportScheduleBody — this means the frontend must always send the complete schedule; a partial JSON-merge patch (Pydantic model_dump(exclude_unset=True)) would be cleaner and avoid accidental field resets.
server.py delete_report_schedule uses delete_many({id: ...}) — should be delete_one and return 404 if not found for API consistency (currently silently returns {deleted: true} for non-existent ids).
copilot.py fallback correctly reads snap['live_xsoar']['noisy_rules_by_fp'] and produces a deterministic answer; behavior is stable in preview (Ollama absent).
xsoar_ingest.compute_detection_overlay derives mitre_coverage as distinct_tactics/14 — matches PRD; overlay is only applied when data_status=='live'.
